{{Infobox league |name=CTF Showdown 3 |image=Showdown_2.png |series= |organizer={{player|Shining|flag=se}} |admin={{player|Elguapo|flag=se}}, {{player|Velocity|flag=se}} |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 (5on5) |prizepool=Glory |date=23 May and 27 May, 2024 |year=2024 |website= |discord=discord.gg/7PdsweWA |twitch= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= |map1= CTF8 |map2= CTF2M1 |map3= E2M2 |map4= CTF5 |map5= Mammoth |map6= |map7= }} We are now excited to present the third edition of CTF Showdown. This tournament will be a two-day thriller, offering everything that was captured during our previous editions. New for this time - Teams will be made up by a Draft! This tournament will consist of 3 teams with 5-6 players which opens up for some 5on5 rounds! == Format == * '''General Information''' ** 10 min rounds ** 4on4 (5on5 is OK if both teams agree!). ** Crhook ** No team damage, Weapons stay * '''Group stage, BO5:''' 23 May, 2024 ** '''Maps:''' Maps order will be randomized from map pool. ** '''Team color:''' Team color will be randomized in advanced and will be the same for each map. ** Standings determined by won games, followed by won rounds followed by total frag difference. * '''Semifinals, BO5:''' 27 May, 2024 ** The second and third place team will face each other in the semis. ** '''Maps:''' Maps order will be randomized from map pool. ** '''Team color:''' Team color will be randomized for each map. ** The first team to win 3 maps wins. * '''Grand Final, BO5:''' 27 May, 2024 ** The first placed team will play the winner of the semis. ** '''Maps:''' Maps order will be randomized from map pool. After each played map a rand will be made between the remaining maps. ** '''Team color:''' Team color will be randomized for each map. ** The first team to win 3 maps wins. == Maps == {{Maps |title= |map1=CTF8 |map2=CTF2M1 |map3=E2M2 |map4=CTF5 |map5=Mammoth }} ==Squads & Teamnames== {| class="wikitable table" style="width:100%;padding:5px;" |- style="font-size:120%;border-right:1px solid red;" |- ! Everyone is welcome to participate. All info in [https://discord.gg/uaMKvnDpwz CTF Discord]. *'''How to get started with CTF''' ** Bind the hook with +fire 22 , or impulse 22 (bind q +fire 22) for example. ** Bind tossrune, to throw away your current rune: (bind r tossrune) for example. ** Practice your hook skills and config on a KTX-server. For example: connect london.badplace.eu:28503, in the console, type: ctf, then type: practice. ** Welcome to try our CTF bots on qwctf.se:28503 == Trailer == {{#ev:youtube|O_7mRtqnjL4|580}} __NOTOC__
